storyCards.fact:
A*teens's "Dancing Queen" reached #95 on the Billboard Hot 100. A-Teens (stylized as A*Teens) are a Swedish pop music group from Stockholm.

The song peaked at #95 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 5 weeks on the chart.

Dancing Queen was released in 2000.
